_note: Physical traits for persona art prompts. This file did NOT exist before 2026-08-18 and was seeded from the only traits stated explicitly by Z; nothing here is inferred from the artwork, because inventing traits is precisely what it must prevent. Character consistency comes from the REFERENCE IMAGES on each call — these strings are a backstop that keeps a distinguishing cue readable when a figure is small, in silhouette, or at depth, where the reference cannot carry it. `team` matches teams_canonical.json exactly; colors are looked up from it at prompt-build time and never hardcoded here.
